Name: Topless Farmer Girl
Author: MangusuPixel
Description:
Allows players to play as a topless or naked farmer girl. Includes 15 edited pants and 1 edited bikini to fit the skinnier body size.

By default, the mod only shows nudity when no shirt is worn (hides the default white undershirt), but config options allow for more customization.
This allows playing alongside characters that are naked, semi-naked, and fully clothed.

This mod also works without displaying any nudity by using the skinny body or barbie-doll body.

[size=4]Config options[/size]
Using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] is strongly advised. Changes made immediately take effect without needing to return to the main menu.
[list]
[*]Hide undershirt: Toggles nudity when no top is worn
[*]Hide all shirts: Toggles nudity for all farmer girls (multiplayer compatible - others without the mod won't know)
[*]Always nude swimming: Toggles nudity while in a bathing suit
[*]Better bikinis: Makes the bikinis fit the skinnier body type
[*]Always show bikini: Toggles bikinis being shown even if all shirts are hidden
[*]Barbie doll: Skinny body textures without the nipples.
[/list]
[size=4]Compatibility[/size][list]
[*]Fully compatible with multiplayer.
[*]Does not support mods that change the female farmer sprites.
[*]Does not support mods that add new pants, but they'll look fine as long as a top is worn.
[*]Should support mods that add new hairstyles but they may include missing pixels.
[*]Does not require mods that hide the default underwear, using them might break things.
[/list]
[size=4]Details[/size]
[list]
[*]No mod requirements, but using Generic Mod Config Menu is strongly suggested.
[*]Source code is only available on my Discord (link below).
[*]No planned updates other than bug fixes.
[/list]
[size=4]Support
[/size]If you have issues, suggestions, or feedback, comment here or join my Discord for a quicker response. If you like my mods, donating is the best way to show appreciation while supporting both me and future updates.
